intent: A 3x3 alignment picker (nine anchor positions) as one radiogroup; its face changes with the frame flow — a single dot (stack) or table cells (grid).
use_when: Picking one of nine alignment / anchor positions in the inspector.
dont_use_when: Freeform numeric position — use NumericInput pairs.

tokens.note: Binds to DS tokens; no hardcoded hex — verified.
tokens.surface: shares the SegmentedControl enclosure (bg/secondary + border ring)

a11y.labels: each cell carries an aria-label (Top left ... Bottom right); arrow-key single selection.
